slots.note: Emperor moth asked; no eyespots came through, so titled Banded Moth.
All four cicadas rejected (grub bodies, wrong legs); lacewing backup has a fine vein net but butterfly-shaped wings, so titled Lace Wings.
Morpho asked; clean veins and scalloped border but no morpho markings, so titled Butterfly.
Ladybird asked; far too many spots, so titled Spotted Beetle; the only seed with head, antennae and legs.
Clean complete orb web on one thread; the dew drops did not come through, so the title does not claim them.
